text:
nina: hitting a weird mobile-only failure in onboarding rerank. Android-only so far. Customer report + our CI on Pixel emulator.

rob: short error? logs?

nina: server returns 400 with message: 
```
{"error":"bad_request","message":"rerank: declared_dim=1530 but item[3] vector length=1536"}
```
This is odd because client is sending full-length vectors. Captured request shows header and body: 
```
POST /v1/rerank
Headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Redwood-Vector-Dim': '1530' }
Body: { "items": [ {"id":"a1","vector":[0.12,0.0, ..., 0.0]}, {"id":"a2","vector":[...1536 floats...]}, ... ] }
```

katy-android: I investigated. Android SDK has a performance optimization where we compute a batch header "X-Redwood-Vector-Dim" from the first vector length before batch padding completes. With concurrent batcher and our async pad routine, the header sometimes reflects the unpadded length (1530) while the JSON body contains padded vectors (1536). Runtime validates header vs declared count and errors.

sam: ah, runtime checks the header when doing fast-path parse for packed payloads. So mismatch becomes a hard reject instead of a soft warning.

nina: repro steps I used: clone mobile-sampleapp -> start emulator -> run onboarding -> occasionally get 400s. Able to catch with Charles proxy.

rob: what's the immediate mitigation?

katy-android: pushing a hotfix to compute the header after pad completes. Also adding a pre-send assert that verifies every item vector.length === modelDim or fail-fast with our own error message. Patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-android/pull/88 

nina: local quick-fix (until patch lands) is to remove the X-Redwood-Vector-Dim header in sampleapp network middleware so runtime falls back to schema-based validation and accepts the request. Doing that for Canary tests.

qa-bot: created ticket https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/901 - "android: header race causing vector-dim mismatch" and added flaky test to capture.

sam: runtime ask: can we relax the fast-path so header mismatch surfaces a warning instead of immediate 400? Or at least return clearer diagnostics like: 
```
400 rerank: header_dim=1530 body_dim=1536 item_idx=3. Hint: client may compute header before padding. See https://go.internal/runtimedocs#vector-dims
```

rob: SDK parity ask: add a mobile vs server integration test that runs small random vectors and asserts header+body consistency across Node/Python/Android/iOS. Also add unit test toggles for padVectors:true|false.

katy-android: adding: - pre-send validator in batch helper - idempotency key per item (so retries don't duplicate) - disable header optimization behind opt-in flag `useVectorHeader` default false until we ship tests.

nina: will run Canary with sampleapp middleware removed once patch merges. Leaving logs and Charles capture in the issue. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:

rob: filing runtime UX ticket RN-466 for clearer error text and a diagnostic header when dims mismatch (X-Redwood-Debug: header_dim=.. body_dim=..).

qa-bot: PRs linked: sdk-android#88, sampleapp#901, runtime#RN-466. Marking this thread resolved for now.
